title: Computational and experimental approach for investigating the microstructural parameters of a cadmium indium selenide (α-CdIn2Se4) ternary semiconducting compound
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14859-14875
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01850A, Paper
Open Access

S. D. Dhruv, Sergei A. Sharko, Aleksandra I. Serokurova, Nikolai N. Novitskii, D. L. Goroshko, Parth Rayani, Jagruti Jangale, Naveen Agrawal, Vanaraj Solanki, J. H. Markna, Bharat Kataria, D. K. Dhruv
The Rietveld refinement (RR) method in the FullProf suite is used to evaluate the X-ray diffraction (XRD) data and estimate the thermal and structural parameters of the ternary semiconducting compound α-(phase) CdIn2Se4.
